{{nihongo|'''Mankusen Shrine'''|万九千神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izumo Province]].

'''Makuse no Yashiro''' (まくせのやしろ), commonly called '''Mankusen Shrine''' (まんくせんじんじゃ)<ref name="yuisyo">{{cite web|title=万九千神社 ご由緒|author=万九千神社|url=http://www.mankusenjinja.jp/our_historical|accessdate=2025-03-15}}</ref>, is a shrine in Hikawa-chō, {{ill|Izumo, Shimane|Q825166|qid=Q825166}}, {{ill|Shimane Prefecture|ace|Prefektur Shimane|af|Shimane-prefektuur|an|Prefectura de Shimane|ar|شيمانه (محافظة)|az|Şimane prefekturası|azb|شیمانه اوستانی|ban|Préféktur Shimané|be|Сіманэ (прэфектура)|bg|Шимане|bn|শিমানে প্রশাসনিক অঞ্চল|ca|Prefectura de Shimane|cdo|Shimane-gâing|ce|Симане (префектура)|ceb|Shimane-ken|ckb|پارێزگای شیمانێ|cs|Prefektura Šimane|cy|Shimane (talaith)|da|Shimane-præfekturet|de|Präfektur Shimane|eo|Gubernio Shimane|es|Prefectura de Shimane|et|Shimane prefektuur|eu|Shimane (prefektura)|fa|استان شیمانه|fi|Shimanen prefektuuri|fr|Préfecture de Shimane|frr|Shimane (Prefektüür)|ga|Maoracht Shimane|gl|Prefectura de Shimane|hak|Shimane-yen|he|שימאנה (מחוז)|hr|Shimane (prefektura)|hu|Simane prefektúra|hy|Սիմանե (պրեֆեկտուրա)|id|Prefektur Shimane|ilo|Prepektura ti Shimane|it|Prefettura di Shimane|ja|島根県|ka|სიმანეს პრეფექტურა|km|ស៊ីម៉ាណិ(ខេត្ត)|ko|시마네현|lt|Šimanės prefektūra|lv|Simanes prefektūra|mk|Шимане (префектура)|mni|ꯁꯤꯃꯥꯅꯦ ꯂꯝꯈꯥꯢ|mr|शिमाने प्रांत|ms|Wilayah Shimane|ne|सिमाने|nl|Shimane (prefectuur)|no|Shimane (prefektur)|os|Симане|pl|Prefektura Shimane|pnb|ضلع شیمانے|ps|شیمانه|pt|Shimane|ro|Prefectura Shimane|ru|Симане|sd|شيماني پريفيڪچر|se|Shimane prefektuvra|sh|Prefektura Shimane|simple|Shimane Prefecture|sk|Šimane (prefektúra)|sr|Префектура Шимане|su|Shimane Prefecture|sv|Shimane prefektur|sw|Mkoa wa Shimane|tg|Префектураи Шимане|th|จังหวัดชิมาเนะ|tl|Prepektura ng Shimane|tr|Shimane|tt|Симане (префектура)|uk|Префектура Сімане|ur|شیمانے پریفیکچر|vi|Shimane|war|Shimane (prefektura)|wuu|岛根县|zh|岛根县|zh_classical|島根縣|zh_min_nan|Simane-koān|zh_yue|島根縣|qid=Q132751}}. It is enshrined as a precinct shrine of {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Tachimushi Shrine}}<ref name="yuisyo"/>. It is said to be the final place in Izumo where the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Yaoyorozu no Kami}} gather during Kamiarizuki. There is no {{ill|Honden|Q2044994|qid=Q2044994}}; behind the shrine hall (equivalent to a {{ill|Haiden (Shinto)|Q3125745|qid=Q3125745}}) are a {{ill|Himorogi|Q60587|qid=Q60587}} (sacred tree) and an {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=iwasaka}}<ref>{{cite web|title=境内のご案内|author=万九千神社|url=http://www.mankusenjinja.jp/shrine|accessdate=2025-03-15}}</ref>.

=== Enshrined deities ===
*Kushimike-nu-no-Mikoto
*Ōanamuchi-no-Mikoto
*Sukunahikona-no-Mikoto
*Yaoyorozu-no-kami

=== Tachimushi Shrine ===
Originally enshrined on a sandbank in the Hii River, but moved into the precincts of Mankusen Shrine in Kanbun 10 (1670) due to flooding. Former village shrine<ref name="yuisyo"/>.

=== Enshrined deities ===
*Itakeru-no-Mikoto
*Ōyatsuhime-no-Mikoto
*Tsumatsuhime-no-Mikoto
